description: This file contains partial class definitions related to Redis-based reminder options, exception handling, and extension methods for integrating Redis reminders into Orleans silos. It includes configuration options, exception classes, and code generation classes for serialization.

classes.name: RedisReminderTableOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for Redis reminders, including connection options, creation of Redis connection, and entry expiry settings.

classes.name: SiloBuilderReminderExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods to configure and use Redis reminder service within Orleans silo builders.

classes.name: RedisRemindersException
classes.description: Custom exception class for Redis reminder errors.

classes.name: Codec_RedisRemindersException
classes.description: Generated codec class for serializing and deserializing RedisRemindersException instances.

classes.name: Copier_RedisRemindersException
classes.description: Helper class for copying exception instances during serialization.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Default method to create a Redis connection multiplexer based on provided options.

methods.name: UseRedisReminderService
methods.description: Extension method to add Redis reminder service to Orleans silo configuration.
